result.instructions: Nebius Scientific AI. GROMACS: upload immutable inputs, submit once with an idempotency key, poll the returned operation ID, then retrieve validated artifacts. Never put large file contents into tool arguments. Status is not a scientific result. Each native App advertises its execution mode. Durable tools return an operation ID; poll it, and reuse the identical idempotency key after a lost admission response. Synchronous tools have no durable retry guarantee. Never retry inference with a new key after a timeout. Tools are filtered by current S2 availability.
